description: Convert a date/time between IANA timezones. Accepts natural language ('3pm PT next Thursday in IST') or structured input (datetime + from + to). Returns the converted ISO timestamp, a human-readable result, and the offset difference in hours.

_signals.x_guidance: x402-tools is a set of pay-per-call utility APIs for AI agents, settled in USDC via the x402 protocol — no API keys, no accounts. Each endpoint is a single POST with a JSON body; an unpaid request returns HTTP 402 with payment requirements, and the same request retried with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header returns the result. Use an x402 client library (e.g. @x402/fetch with @x402/svm for Solana or @x402/evm for Base/Polygon) to handle the payment handshake. Prices are fixed per endpoint and listed under x-payment-info on each operation.
